CONTROL THE POCKET

Space / Snap ballSnap the ball. After a play ends, press to line up at the new spot, then press again to snap.W A S D / ArrowsMove the quarterback or the receiver carrying the ball. Hold Shift to sprint, or Alt to jog. Backpedaling is slower.1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5Press a receiver’s number to throw directly to them after the snap. Click or tap their label for the same action.Hold click / FOptional hold F and release to throw to the selected receiver. The receiver buttons throw immediately; no aiming is required.V / Watch replayAfter the whistle, watch the last six seconds from the sideline. Press V again to exit.R / P / CReset the current play without restoring clock time / choose a concept / change camera.EscapePause or resume the session.

Pass before crossing the blue line of scrimmage. Stamina affects movement. Passes track the chosen receiver; nearby defenders can swat or intercept them. Your linemen protect the pocket. Defenders cover, rush, and can intercept a pass. After a catch, control transfers to the receiver, who runs upfield automatically. Use WASD to steer and Shift to sprint. Defenders pursue and tackle. The next play lines up at the end-of-play yard line; incomplete passes return to the previous spot. The game clock runs from snap until the play ends and remains paused during conversions. Touchdowns add six points, followed by a timed extra-point kick or a playable two-point try.

Original football practice game with code-driven routes, coverage, blocking, catches and scoring. All teams and stadium graphics are fictional. Full matches, advanced contact physics and production motion-capture clips remain outside this prototype.

PRACTICE SETTINGS

Developer graphics tools

Camera and conditions apply to the next snap. Rain affects acceleration and footing. Targeted passes compensate for wind. Choose Low graphics for a lighter workload. Medium and High add crowd detail and post-processing when supported.
